edges.reason: The swap caller identity is forwarded into IEmpireCallee.empireCall, giving untrusted code control flow inside the locked swap before the K invariant is finalised.
The sweep caller is an untrusted token contract invoked through empireSweepCall after sweepable tokens have already been sent out.
The sweep caller decides which reserve is used as _reserveSwept/_reserveSweeper and therefore the resulting sweptAmount.
block.timestamp feeds blockTimestamp and timeElapsed inside _update.
burn authorisation depends on block.timestamp >= liquidityLocked.
permit validity depends on block.timestamp compared to the submitted deadline.
createPair grants locked/sweepable pair privileges when msg.sender is one of the tokens.
transferFrom consumes allowance[from][msg.sender].
approve writes the allowance of msg.sender.
transfer debits the msg.sender balance.
swap reads token0 for the optimistic transfer and the INVALID_TO check.
swap reads token1 for the optimistic transfer and the INVALID_TO check.
swap reads reserve0 for output limits and input computation.
swap reads reserve1 for output limits and input computation.
sweep reads sweptAmount to enforce the max-sweepable floor.
sweepableToken selects which token sweep transfers out.
The lock modifier reads and writes unlocked to serialise entry into swap.
initialize requires msg.sender == factory, the immutable deployment caller.
liquidityLocked gates the burn entry point.
_mint increases totalSupply.
_mint credits balanceOf[to].
_burn decreases totalSupply.
_burn debits balanceOf[from].
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
_update writes reserve0.
_update writes reserve1.
_update writes blockTimestampLast.
_update accumulates price0CumulativeLast with an overflowing-by-design addition.
_update accumulates price1CumulativeLast with an overflowing-by-design addition.
initialize writes token0.
initialize writes token1.
initialize writes liquidityLocked for non-common pair types.
initialize writes sweepableToken for sweepable pair types.
initialize writes empirePairType.
initialize writes empireLockTime.
mint refreshes kLast after _update.
burn refreshes kLast after _update.
sweep updates sweptAmount by the swept amount and enforces the computed maxSweepable ceiling.
unsweep decreases sweptAmount by the returned amount.
createPair records the new pair in both directions of getPair.
createPair pushes the new pair onto allPairs.
setFeeTo writes feeTo after verifying msg.sender == feeToSetter.
setFeeToSetter writes feeToSetter after verifying msg.sender == feeToSetter.
createPair calls initialize on the freshly deployed pair.
The 2-argument createPair overload delegates to the 4-argument createPair.
createEmpirePair delegates to createPair.
mint calls _mintFee before computing minted liquidity.
mint calls _update at the end of the liquidity event.
mint calls _mint to issue LP tokens.
burn calls _mintFee for protocol fee accounting.
burn calls _update after transferring the underlying tokens out.
burn calls _burn on the pair's own LP balance.
burn performs the optimistic token transfers via _safeTransfer.
burn relies on the token transfer helpers that wrap _safeCall.
swap sends output tokens with _safeTransfer before the callback and K check.
swap calls _update to persist reserves and cumulative prices.
swap evaluates the constant-product invariant after all transfers and the callback.
skim transfers the excess balance using _safeTransfer.
sync overwrites reserves via _update from the live balances.
sweep transfers the sweepable token out via _safeTransfer.
unsweep pulls tokens back with _safeTransferFrom.
getMaxSweepable uses getAmountOut for the pricing formula.
approve calls the private _approve.
transfer calls the private _transfer.
transferFrom calls the private _transfer after allowance bookkeeping.
permit calls _approve once the recovered signer matches owner.
_safeTransfer routes the encoded transfer selector into _safeCall.
_safeTransferFrom routes the encoded transferFrom selector into _safeCall.
_safeCall performs the raw token.call on the untrusted token address.
swap invokes the flash-swap callback on the caller-supplied to address while the lock is held.
sweep invokes empireSweepCall on the untrusted caller token after transferring tokens out.
permit derives the signer with ecrecover and compares it to owner.
sweep computes amountIn by subtracting a reserve from an externally supplied totalSupply.
unsweep subtracts the returned amount from sweptAmount.
createPair uses inline assembly create2 to deploy the pair deterministically.
_mintFee reads factory.feeTo() to decide whether protocol fees are on.
block.timestamp derived timeElapsed scales the price0CumulativeLast accrual.
block.timestamp derived timeElapsed scales the price1CumulativeLast accrual.

normalization_plan.reason: The swap recipient parameter is only used within the swap entry point and must be normalised into it.
Requested token0 output is local to the swap entry point.
Requested token1 output is local to the swap entry point.
The swap callback data is passed straight into the untrusted empireCall invocation.
balance0 only feeds the balance0Adjusted computation of the K invariant.
balance1 only feeds the balance1Adjusted computation of the K invariant.
amount0In is derived from balances and used exclusively in the invariant check.
amount1In is derived from balances and used exclusively in the invariant check.
Adjusted token0 balance is a pure intermediate of the invariant check.
Adjusted token1 balance is a pure intermediate of the invariant check.
The swept amount parameter is consumed solely by the sweep entry point.
Sweep calldata is forwarded verbatim into the empireSweepCall callback.
amountIn is produced by the unchecked totalSupply subtraction expression.
amountOut is an intermediate of the sweep pricing computation.
maxSweepable is the sweep-only ceiling used in the require statement.
The unsweep amount parameter is used only inside unsweep.
The permit owner parameter is bound to the permit entry point signature check.
The permit spender parameter is only used to grant the allowance.
The permit value parameter is only used to grant the allowance.
The permit deadline parameter is only compared against block.timestamp in permit.
tokenA is consumed by the createPair sorting and duplicate checks.
tokenB is consumed by the createPair sorting and duplicate checks.
pairType drives the privilege gate and the unlockTime override in createPair.
unlockTime is passed to the pair initializer only from createPair.
The truncated timestamp local exists only inside _update.
timeElapsed is only used to scale the cumulative price accruals in _update.
_token0 is written to token0 only inside initialize.
_token1 is written to token1 only inside initialize.
